title: Volcano Hybrid Onyx Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
ALL STORZ VAPORIZERS ARE REGULAR STOCK

VOLCANO HYBRID SILVER ALSO AVAILABLE

The latest vaporizer from Storz & Bickel: the reinvention of an icon.

ONYX Edition: Fearless, bold and daring.

The new limited VOLCANO ONYX edition is an absolute eye-catcher. The ONYX color is reminiscent of black lava rock, which perfectly matches the VOLCANO’s iconic shape. The high-quality powder coating makes the cone even more scratch-resistant, and the matte black makes for a strong appearance of extravagance. There’s no question that the proven long-lasting quality from STORZ & BICKEL continues with this limited ONYX edition.

The Volcano Hybrid comes with the following
Volcano Hybrid Hot Air Generator
1 power cord
3 Easy Valve balloon with mouthpiece
1 Easy Valve balloon with Adapter
1 Tube System
1 Filling Chamber (including 1 cap ring, 1 normal screen set, 1 drip pad, 1 cleaning brush
1 Air Filter Set
1 Herb Mill

EXTRA ITEMS AVAILABLE FOR $20: 1 EASY VALVE BALLOON, 1 SOLID VALVE BOX OF BAGS, 1 EASY VALVE SCREEN SET, 2 CLEANING STICKS, 1 CLEANING BRUSH

Visit the manufacturer website for Volcano Hybrid warranty information – 3 year limited warranty
https://www.storz-bickel.com/shop_us/en/support/
